result.instructions: Tools for Eventbrite, hosted by usefulapi.io. Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes Eventbrite data. Free plan: 100 tool calls per month. Run eventbrite_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run eventbrite_request_feature to record the request. Pro (unlimited calls, $9/month or $90/year): when the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run eventbrite_upgrade; it returns a Stripe Checkout link for the user to open. eventbrite_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: eventbrite_get_me
tools.title: Get my user
tools.description: Fetch the Eventbrite user the token belongs to (name, emails). A cheap way to confirm the token works. Eventbrite: GET /users/me/.

tools.name: eventbrite_list_organizations
tools.title: List my organizations
tools.description: List the organizations you are a member of. Almost every other tool needs an organization_id from here. Eventbrite: GET /users/me/organizations/.

continuation.description: pagination.continuation from the previous page. Omit for the first page.

tools.name: eventbrite_list_events
tools.title: List an organization's events
tools.description: List the events of an organization, filterable by status, name and past/upcoming. Eventbrite: GET /organizations/{organization_id}/events/.

organization_id.description: Organization ID (from eventbrite_list_organizations). This is NOT the organizer id in an organizer profile URL.

time_filter.description: Past, or current and future, events.

name_filter.description: Only events whose name matches this text.

continuation.description: pagination.continuation from the previous page. Omit for the first page.

tools.name: eventbrite_get_event
tools.title: Get an event
tools.description: Fetch one event: name, summary, start/end, status, capacity, venue_id, listing settings. Use expand=venue,ticket_classes for more. Eventbrite: GET /events/{event_id}/.

tools.name: eventbrite_get_event_description
tools.title: Get an event's full description
tools.description: Fetch the fully rendered HTML description of an event (summary plus the page modules). Eventbrite: GET /events/{event_id}/description/.

tools.name: eventbrite_list_ticket_classes
tools.title: List an event's ticket classes
tools.description: List the ticket types of an event with price, capacity, quantity_sold and sales window. Eventbrite: GET /events/{event_id}/ticket_classes/.

pos.description: Only tickets valid for this point of sale.

continuation.description: pagination.continuation from the previous page. Omit for the first page.

tools.name: eventbrite_list_venues
tools.title: List an organization's venues
tools.description: List the saved venues of an organization, with address and capacity. Eventbrite: GET /organizations/{organization_id}/venues/.

organization_id.description: Organization ID (from eventbrite_list_organizations). This is NOT the organizer id in an organizer profile URL.

continuation.description: pagination.continuation from the previous page. Omit for the first page.

tools.name: eventbrite_list_attendees
tools.title: List attendees
tools.description: List attendees (one per sold ticket) of one event OR of all of an organization's events. Each attendee carries checked_in, cancelled, refunded, status, ticket_class_name, profile and barcodes (status unused/used). Pass exactly one of event_id / organization_id. Eventbrite: GET /events/{event_id}/attendees/ or GET /organizations/{organization_id}/attendees/.

event_id.description: Event ID — list this event's attendees.

organization_id.description: Organization ID — list attendees across all its events.

status.description: attending = Attending or Checked In; not_attending = Not Attending or Deleted; unpaid (event only) = order not paid.

changed_since.description: Only attendees changed on or after this time, in UTC, e.g. 2026-12-01T02:00:00Z.

continuation.description: pagination.continuation from the previous page. Omit for the first page.

tools.name: eventbrite_get_attendee
tools.title: Get an attendee
tools.description: Fetch one attendee of an event, including check-in state (checked_in, barcodes[].status), answers and cost breakdown. Eventbrite: GET /events/{event_id}/attendees/{attendee_id}/.

tools.name: eventbrite_list_orders
tools.title: List orders
tools.description: List orders of one event OR of all of an organization's events: buyer name/email, status, costs. Pass exactly one of event_id / organization_id. Eventbrite: GET /events/{event_id}/orders/ or GET /organizations/{organization_id}/orders/.

event_id.description: Event ID — list this event's orders.

organization_id.description: Organization ID — list orders across all its events.

status.description: active = attending orders, inactive = not attending, both, or all_not_deleted.

changed_since.description: Only orders changed on or after this time, in UTC, e.g. 2026-12-01T02:00:00Z.

continuation.description: pagination.continuation from the previous page. Omit for the first page.

tools.name: eventbrite_get_order
tools.title: Get an order
tools.description: Fetch one order. Use expand=attendees,event to include its tickets and event. Eventbrite: GET /orders/{order_id}/.

tools.name: eventbrite_list_discounts
tools.title: List discounts
tools.description: Search an organization's discounts and access codes, with quantity_sold. scope=event needs event_id; multi_events = cross-event discounts; user = all of the organization's. Eventbrite: GET /organizations/{organization_id}/discounts/.

organization_id.description: Organization ID (from eventbrite_list_organizations). This is NOT the organizer id in an organizer profile URL.

code.description: Exact code or name match. Not together with code_filter.

code_filter.description: Approximate code or name match. Not together with code.

continuation.description: pagination.continuation from the previous page. Omit for the first page.

tools.name: eventbrite_get_capacity
tools.title: Get an event's capacity
tools.description: Fetch the event capacity tier: capacity_total, capacity_sold, capacity_pending, quantity_total and capacity holds. Eventbrite: GET /events/{event_id}/capacity_tier/.

tools.name: eventbrite_list_inventory_tiers
tools.title: List an event's inventory tiers
tools.description: List the inventory tiers of a tiered or reserved-seating event, with quantity_total, quantity_sold, quantity_pending and linked ticket_class_ids. Eventbrite: GET /events/{event_id}/inventory_tiers/.

count_against_event_capacity.description: Only tiers that do (true) or do not (false, e.g. add-ons) count against event capacity.

continuation.description: pagination.continuation from the previous page. Omit for the first page.

tools.name: eventbrite_get_sales_report
tools.title: Get a sales report
tools.description: Sales report for one or more events: gross, net, fees, royalty and quantity per time bucket, optionally grouped (by ticket, payment method, country, ...). Eventbrite: GET /reports/sales/.

event_ids.description: One or more Event IDs to report on.

group_by.description: Group the report by this dimension.

date_facet.description: Time bucket for the data points (default day).

period.description: Number of date_facet units back from now, e.g. date_facet=hour + period=3 = last 3 hours.

timezone.description: Timezone for the report (default: the first event's).

tools.name: eventbrite_get_attendee_report
tools.title: Get an attendee report
tools.description: Attendee report for one or more events: number of attendees and orders per time bucket, optionally grouped. Eventbrite: GET /reports/attendees/.

event_ids.description: One or more Event IDs to report on.

group_by.description: Group the report by this dimension.

date_facet.description: Time bucket for the data points (default day).

period.description: Number of date_facet units back from now, e.g. date_facet=hour + period=3 = last 3 hours.

timezone.description: Timezone for the report (default: the first event's).

tools.name: eventbrite_create_event
tools.title: Create a draft event
tools.description: Create a new event as a DRAFT (not visible or on sale until eventbrite_publish_event). Add tickets with eventbrite_create_ticket_class before publishing. Eventbrite: POST /organizations/{organization_id}/events/.

organization_id.description: Organization ID (from eventbrite_list_organizations). This is NOT the organizer id in an organizer profile URL.

timezone.description: Olson timezone of the event, e.g. America/Los_Angeles or Europe/London.

summary.description: Plain-text summary, max 140 characters (Eventbrite's replacement for the old description field).

online_event.description: True if the event is online-only (no venue). Cannot be combined with venue_id.

organizer_id.description: Organizer profile ID. Omit to use the default organizer.

invite_only.description: Only invited people can see the event page. Mutually exclusive with listed.

show_remaining.description: Show the number of tickets left on the event page.

capacity.description: Event capacity. Omit to use the sum of the ticket class capacities.

hide_start_date.description: Hide the start date from attendees.

hide_end_date.description: Hide the end date from attendees.

tools.name: eventbrite_update_event
tools.title: Update an event
tools.description: Change fields of an existing event; only the fields you pass are sent. Changing start/end needs timezone too. Eventbrite: POST /events/{event_id}/.

start_utc.description: New start time, in UTC, e.g. 2026-12-01T02:00:00Z.

end_utc.description: New end time, in UTC, e.g. 2026-12-01T02:00:00Z.

timezone.description: Olson timezone of the event, e.g. America/Los_Angeles or Europe/London.

currency.description: ISO 4217 currency (not changeable after paid sales).

summary.description: Plain-text summary, max 140 characters (Eventbrite's replacement for the old description field).

online_event.description: True if the event is online-only (no venue). Cannot be combined with venue_id.

organizer_id.description: Organizer profile ID. Omit to use the default organizer.

invite_only.description: Only invited people can see the event page. Mutually exclusive with listed.

show_remaining.description: Show the number of tickets left on the event page.

capacity.description: Event capacity. Omit to use the sum of the ticket class capacities.

hide_start_date.description: Hide the start date from attendees.

hide_end_date.description: Hide the end date from attendees.

tools.name: eventbrite_copy_event
tools.title: Copy an event
tools.description: Duplicate an event (tickets, payment options, refund policy, tax settings) into a new event with a new ID, optionally with a new name and dates. Eventbrite: POST /events/{event_id}/copy/.

start_date.description: Start of the new event, in UTC, e.g. 2026-12-01T02:00:00Z.

end_date.description: End of the new event, in UTC, e.g. 2026-12-01T02:00:00Z.

timezone.description: Olson timezone for the new event.

tools.name: eventbrite_publish_event
tools.title: Publish an event
tools.description: Make a draft event live so tickets go on sale. Needs a name, organizer, at least one ticket class and valid payment options. Undo with eventbrite_unpublish_event while there are no orders. Eventbrite: POST /events/{event_id}/publish/.

tools.name: eventbrite_unpublish_event
tools.title: Unpublish an event
tools.description: Take a published event back to unpublished. Only allowed while it has no pending or completed orders (or, for paid events, once completed and paid out). Eventbrite: POST /events/{event_id}/unpublish/.

tools.name: eventbrite_create_ticket_class
tools.title: Create a ticket class
tools.description: Add a ticket type to an event. Paid: set cost like "USD,2500" and capacity. Free: free=true and capacity. Eventbrite: POST /events/{event_id}/ticket_classes/.

free.description: True for a free ticket (then omit cost).

donation.description: True for a donation ticket (buyer picks the amount).

cost.description: Ticket price as "<CURRENCY>,<minor units>", e.g. "USD,1000" is $10.00. Must match the event currency. Only for paid tickets.

capacity.description: How many of this ticket can be sold. Required for normal (non-donation, non-tiered) tickets.

sales_start.description: When sales open, in UTC, e.g. 2026-12-01T02:00:00Z.

sales_end.description: When sales close, in UTC, e.g. 2026-12-01T02:00:00Z.

hidden.description: Hide this ticket from the event page.

include_fee.description: Absorb the Eventbrite fee into the displayed price.

sales_channels.description: Where it is sold: ["online"], ["atd"] (at the door) or both.

inventory_tier_id.description: Inventory tier to attach the ticket to (required for tiered events).

order_confirmation_message.description: Message shown on the order confirmation for this ticket.

tools.name: eventbrite_update_ticket_class
tools.title: Update a ticket class
tools.description: Change a ticket type (name, price, capacity, sales window, visibility); only the fields you pass are sent. The price cannot change after tickets are sold. Eventbrite: POST /events/{event_id}/ticket_classes/{ticket_class_id}/.

free.description: True for a free ticket (then omit cost).

donation.description: True for a donation ticket (buyer picks the amount).

cost.description: Ticket price as "<CURRENCY>,<minor units>", e.g. "USD,1000" is $10.00. Must match the event currency. Only for paid tickets.

capacity.description: How many of this ticket can be sold. Required for normal (non-donation, non-tiered) tickets.

sales_start.description: When sales open, in UTC, e.g. 2026-12-01T02:00:00Z.

sales_end.description: When sales close, in UTC, e.g. 2026-12-01T02:00:00Z.

hidden.description: Hide this ticket from the event page.

include_fee.description: Absorb the Eventbrite fee into the displayed price.

sales_channels.description: Where it is sold: ["online"], ["atd"] (at the door) or both.

inventory_tier_id.description: Inventory tier to attach the ticket to (required for tiered events).

order_confirmation_message.description: Message shown on the order confirmation for this ticket.

tools.name: eventbrite_create_venue
tools.title: Create a venue
tools.description: Save a new venue under an organization, to use as an event's venue_id. Eventbrite: POST /organizations/{organization_id}/venues/.

organization_id.description: Organization ID (from eventbrite_list_organizations). This is NOT the organizer id in an organizer profile URL.

country.description: ISO 3166-1 two-letter country code, e.g. US.

google_place_id.description: Google Place ID for the venue.

organizer_id.description: Organizer the venue belongs to (omit for the default).

tools.name: eventbrite_create_discount
tools.title: Create a discount or access code
tools.description: Create a promo code (type=coded), a public discount (type=public, single event) or an access code that unlocks hidden tickets (type=access). Scope: event_id (+ticket_class_ids) for one event, ticket_group_id for a group, neither for all the organization's events. Eventbrite: POST /organizations/{organization_id}/discounts/.

organization_id.description: Organization ID (from eventbrite_list_organizations). This is NOT the organizer id in an organizer profile URL.

type.description: coded = promo code, public = shown on the listing, access = unlocks hidden tickets.

code.description: The code (or the public discount's name). No spaces for coded/access.

amount_off.description: Fixed amount off in the event currency, e.g. "10" or "7.50". Not together with percent_off.

percent_off.description: Percentage off, 1.00–100.00, e.g. "20". Not together with amount_off.

event_id.description: Limit to one event. Omit (with ticket_group_id also omitted) for an organization-wide discount.

ticket_class_ids.description: Limit to these ticket classes of event_id.

quantity_available.description: How many times it can be used; 0 = unlimited.

start_date.description: Usable from, naive local time in the event's timezone, e.g. 2026-11-01T09:00:00.

end_date.description: Usable until, naive local time in the event's timezone, e.g. 2026-11-01T09:00:00.

annotations.title: Create a discount or access code

tools.title: Update a discount

event_id.description: Limit to one event. Omit (with ticket_group_id also omitted) for an organization-wide discount.

ticket_class_ids.description: Limit to these ticket classes of event_id.

quantity_available.description: How many times it can be used; 0 = unlimited.

start_date.description: Usable from, naive local time in the event's timezone, e.g. 2026-11-01T09:00:00.
